relationships.subject: ENT1−/− mice
relationships.evidence_quote: In both female and male mice, CGRP immunoreactivity in the dorsal horn of the cervical spinal cord was elevated in ENT1−/− mice relative to wild-type (Fig. 6A).

relationships.subject: ENT1−/− mice
relationships.evidence_quote: Both GFAP and IBA1 immunoreactivity within the dorsal horn of the cervical spinal cord were significantly increased in female ENT1−/− mice compared to wild-type (Fig. 6B, C).

key_findings: ENT1-/- DISH model mice show axial stiffness/discomfort with progressive spine calcification and elevated cervical dorsal horn CGRP, with GFAP/IBA1 elevated in females.
